choice: the jobs table: a ready or verdict counts when a job of its role on the ticket has handoff_comment_id equal to the comment id
why: #191 already writes that id on orch job done and T6 writes it on recovery; no new table

choice: Registration enum REGISTERED, PENDING, UNREGISTERED in lib/dispatch/types.py
why: a harness posts before it runs orch job done, and a job can post then die; PENDING leaves the comment unhandled for the next poll instead of waking Grok

choice: a failed job's ready at a head T2 has not read passes the gate
why: T6 waits on T2 for that ready (done-deferred); gating it would deadlock both

choice: _answered_by skips an unregistered ready or verdict
why: test: a stray APPROVE after a ready made T2 record the review answered, then T4 rejected the verdict, so no review ran

choice: trust-only while the ticket has no builder job
why: issue #59 projects build outside the queue, so no job can register their ready

choice: conftest keeps the gate open unless a test is marked job_bound
why: the plan measured 832 legacy failures from fixtures that post handoffs no job registered; the brief forbids running the whole suite locally, so a file-by-file fixture pass cannot be measured in this job. The real gate runs in tests/test_job_bound_accept.py
a rejected handoff leaves state as it was and a deferred one is a no-op poll

choice: supersede, latest-verdict and verdict-after lookups call _counted_verdict: trusted and not UNREGISTERED
why: the reviewer's repro: a rejected stray REVISE still superseded a held APPROVE, spent a ship retry and staled a registered fix ready; PENDING still counts so a verdict posted before orch job done keeps blocking a merge

choice: a running review makes a verdict PENDING only at that review's head and round (round unchecked when the job has none)
why: handoff_check validates a verdict against its own job's reviewed head; a review at another head can never register it

choice: verdict_heads still records a rejected stray
why: no failing test reached it inside the round's budget (only _ci_failure_carried reads it); left open in the handoff

choice: _verdict_handled skips a verdict handled as rejected-unregistered-verdict; verdict_heads may still record it
why: the reviewer's CI-carry repro: a rejected stray REVISE counted as the handled verdict, so a later ready queued an extra CI fix; filtering at the join covers a verdict recorded while still PENDING, which filtering in _remember_verdicts would miss

choice: _can_register and _handoff_candidate compare the verdict's full round field with the review job's detail round (N/CAP), not only N
why: lib/handoff_check.py compares the whole field; detail.py writes only N/CAP or None; a failed 1/3 review also took a 1/9 verdict as its handoff via _handoff_candidate

choice: copy its exact-string rule rather than call expected_for
why: importing lib.handoff_check from lib.dispatch.core makes an import cycle through lib.brief and lib.github_actions
